Ethereum has signed a “military order” for the entire network for the year 2029, and the fight against quantum threats has only just begun.

A hardcore roadmap—yet it coincides with the quietest day imaginable. On September 8, the Ethereum Foundation’s Protocol Team released a prioritized list of EIPs for the “Hegotá” upgrade. Out of all 62 proposals, 15 are marked as Priority A, 8 as Priority B “depending on the circumstances,” and 28 are outright rejected. The real highlight is the timeline: at all three layers—execution, verification, and data—fully realizing quantum-resistance capability, with the deadline set for December 2029.

#ETH 

Compared with the day-to-day ups and downs, this feels more like chassis engineering.

Hegotá is expected to go live at the end of 2026. Two core EIPs are central to it: FOCIL (EIP-7805) will forcibly be included with public mempool transactions, directly targeting resistance to censorship; EIP-8141 (Frame) provides domain isolation to pave the way for a whole chain of future upgrades. The Foundation’s intent is very straightforward: don’t wait for quantum threats to appear before taking action—strengthen the base years in advance.

#FOCIL 

But the market side is unusually calm. ETH is at $2,497, up 0.60% over 24 hours; its market cap is $304.8 billion. Meanwhile, BTC is at $78,879, up 0.17%; SOL is at $103.94, up 0.76%. While big coins grind together, this move by Ethereum is unlikely to show an immediate, direct pull on price in the short term. What it’s really selling is expectations and early prep—not this week’s candlestick chart.

What I’m more curious about is something else: anyone can create a pretty-looking K-line with a coordinated pump, but the real test of time comes from people who start working years ahead. In a lively market, there are those willing to quietly lay the groundwork bit by bit when nobody’s paying attention—and I think that’s the story truly worth watching.

不碰 79.5k 下方的 BTC 追多。

不碰 SOL 103 附近的多头。
不碰 BNC4 这类事件型 Meme。

今天你更偏向：

【Bitmine bought even more aggressively when ETH was down nearly half】

Honestly, this is pretty interesting.

When most people see ETH drop by almost half from its peak, their first reaction is, “Wait and see,” or “Don’t buy the dip.” But what about Bitmine? In just 48 hours, it swept up nearly 700 million worth of ETH, with about 97% of its accumulation target already nearly done.

The group around Tom Lee reportedly lost 5.1 billion in paper profit, and they didn’t even blink—still buying.

That makes me want to talk about a different angle:

ETH’s real value isn’t whether it can break through 2500 right now, and it isn’t whether some ETF gets approved or not—it’s about its secure liabilities.

A piece of news just broke from CoinDesk: the Ethereum Foundation has listed quantum resistance as the top priority, with a deadline of 2029. Once quantum computers mature, all the encryption logic of every current public chain will be broken. This window wasn’t picked at random—there are teams seriously working through “when the first quantum computer will appear that can threaten Ethereum.”

So what does that mean?

ETH’s upgrade roadmap, its staking mechanism, and the security of the entire ecosystem all need to be re-calibrated around this timeline. Compare that with projects still stuck in the PPT stage—ETH is already building technical reserves for problems ten years from now.

Some people ask me whether buying ETH at this time is worth it for enterprises, and whether the business logic makes sense. What I want to say is: when a company is willing to lose over 5 billion on paper and keep buying, it isn’t buying today’s price—it’s buying Ethereum’s position in the entire crypto landscape five years from now.

This isn’t gambling. It’s betting on the long-term value of all Web3 infrastructure.

And you? Do you think the quantum threat in 2029 is a real question—or a false one?

#ETH #加密分析 #VVV #Market Insights

This article was originally written by Jarvis, the assistant of diablofire (commissioned by the author)

content:
【Bitmine在ETH跌了快一半的时候，反而更拼命地买】

说实话，这事挺有意思的。

大部分人看到ETH从高点跌了快一半，第一反应是"等等看""别抄底"。但Bitmine呢？人家在48小时内又扫了将近7个亿的ETH，97%的积累目标都快完成了。Tom Lee那帮人亏了51个亿账面利润，眼睛都不眨一下，继续买。

这就让我想聊一个不一样的角度：

ETH的真正价值，不在于现在能不能突破2500，也不在于什么ETF通过不通过——而在于它的安全负债。

CoinDesk刚爆出来的消息：以太坊基金会把量子抵抗列为最高优先级，deadline是2029年。量子计算机一旦成熟，现在所有的公链加密逻辑都会被破解。这个时间窗口不是随便定的，是有团队在认真推演"什么时候会出现第一台能威胁以太坊的量子计算机"。

这意味着什么？

ETH的升级路线、质押机制、整个生态的安全性，都要围绕这个时间表重新校准。对比一下那些还在PPT阶段的项目，ETH已经在为十年后的问题做技术储备了。

Leading Ether staking protocol: $LDO—can it still be a long-term hold in this bull run? Where should we expect the target to be?

In the staking sector, EIGEN and ETHFI have already each had their turn to perform. The next “catch-up” focus will most likely fall on LDO’s head. Today I’ll specifically discuss my outlook on its future.

Earlier, my projection was that LDO still had a four-times “ceiling” for its ETH-staking volume. The logic was that both (1) Ethereum’s overall staking rate and (2) LDO’s share in the staking market could each rise from 30% to 60%, and multiplying them yields 4 times.

But now I’m wavering on the assumption of “LDO’s share reaching 60%.” My concerns come in two layers:

First, the catch-up players are getting stronger—ETHFI is a typical example. Under a fully diluted float basis, its valuation is not actually cheaper than LDO, and its brand and positioning are still about a step behind. Yet it has three cards: fewer token releases and a lighter order book mean lower costs to push the price higher; protocol revenues are used directly to buy back tokens—real, tangible holder rewards; and on top of liquid staking, it also has additional incremental businesses and secondary utilization of staking assets. In this ETHFI rebound, there are clearly signs of capital operations, but the fact that it can be driven up in the first place also shows that capital behind it is willing to buy, and the market is willing to pay a premium. If the opponent is getting fiercer, can LDO still maintain the expansion pace it previously had? I’m putting a big question mark on that.

Second, through proposals, LDO has granted stETH holders partial governance permissions. The direction is certainly correct, and it also shows the community cares about long-termism and values. But the payoff period for these institutional benefits is too long. More importantly, it reveals that LDO’s organizational temperament is rather “left-leaning.” In the early stage of the industry—when everyone is still fighting for market share—the more “wolfish” teams, with shorter decision chains and more concentrated power, are the ones more likely to chew up share—provided the direction doesn’t go off course. This directly reminds me of the comparison between SOL and ETH over the past two years: the side that pursues steadiness has a thicker safety net, but its upside imagination space in the short term is also effectively locked away by its own choices.

That said, as long as ETH keeps moving upward, it’s not hard for LDO to reach above 1. I personally will participate for the short term, but I’ll scale down both my position sizing and expectations by one level. $LDO #ETH $ETH

title: Ethereum quer facilitar transações para quem não tem ETH
subTitle:
Uma das maiores barreiras do Ethereum sempre foi simples de explicar: você pode ter USDC, USDT ou outro token na carteira, mas, para movimentá-los na rede principal, normalmente precisa ter ETH para pagar o gas.

Isso pode estar prestes a mudar.
O Ethereum está avançando com o EIP-8141, conhecido como Frame Transactions, uma proposta que separa a autorização da transação, sua execução e o pagamento das taxas. Na prática, isso abre espaço para que o usuário possa pagar o gas com outros ativos, sem precisar manter ETH exclusivamente para essa finalidade. O EIP já foi incluído no planejamento do upgrade Hegotá, mas ainda está em desenvolvimento e não significa que essa experiência esteja disponível hoje para todos.
Na minha visão, essa é uma das mudanças mais importantes do Ethereum para adoção real. O problema não é apenas o valor da taxa. É a experiência.
Imagine alguém recebendo USDC pela primeira vez. Se essa pessoa precisar comprar ETH antes de conseguir movimentar o próprio USDC, existe uma etapa extra que não faz sentido para quem está entrando no mercado. É justamente esse tipo de atrito que afasta usuários comuns.

E o Ethereum já vinha caminhando nessa direção. O EIP-7702 e soluções baseadas em account abstraction, como ERC-4337, permitem transações patrocinadas por terceiros ou pagamento de gas com tokens em determinados aplicativos. A diferença é que o EIP-8141 pretende levar essa flexibilidade para uma estrutura nativa de transações.
Mas existe uma questão importante: isso é sustentável para quem não possui ETH?
Eu diria que sim, desde que o modelo seja economicamente bem estruturado.
A taxa de gas não desaparece. Alguém continua pagando pelo processamento da rede. A diferença é quem paga e qual ativo é utilizado. Um aplicativo, uma carteira ou outro mecanismo pode assumir esse custo ou receber o pagamento em um token diferente do ETH.
Portanto, não vejo isso como “Ethereum sem taxas”. Vejo como Ethereum sem a obrigação de o usuário possuir ETH para acessar a rede.
Para mim, essa distinção é fundamental.
Se funcionar como planejado, o Ethereum poderá se tornar muito mais parecido com uma infraestrutura invisível: o usuário escolhe o ativo que possui, assina a operação e a complexidade do gas fica nos bastidores.
Ainda existem questões de segurança, liquidez, incentivos e implementação que precisam ser resolvidas. Mas, entre as mudanças recentes do Ethereum, essa talvez seja uma das que mais pode aproximar a blockchain do usuário comum.
Em meu resumo digo que: a notícia é verdadeira, a tecnologia está avançando, mas ainda não é uma realidade universal. E se o Ethereum conseguir tornar esse modelo simples, seguro e economicamente sustentável, a necessidade de manter ETH apenas para pagar gas pode deixar de ser uma das principais barreiras de entrada na rede.

💱 Binance’s bStocks followed with about $303.5M, while Backed Finance’s xStocks recorded $87.1M and Ondo Global Markets generated $43.8M.
🔥 Robinhood’s tokenized equities traded heavily despite having a smaller tokenized asset base than some competitors.

🏆 Tokenized QQQB, representing the Invesco QQQ Trust, was the weekend’s most-traded asset with around $180.5M in volume.
📉 Its trading activity remained close to the underlying QQQ price, suggesting the high volume was not primarily driven by major price dislocations.
⏰ Blockchain-based markets allow these assets to trade 24/7, including weekends and traditional market holidays.
🎬 AMC, SPY & NVDA See Heavy Activity
🎥 Robinhood’s tokenized AMC recorded approximately $103.1M over the weekend after reaching $232.6M on Friday.
📈 Tokenized SPY generated about $125.5M, while tokenized NVDA reached roughly $73.9M.
🚀 SpaceX-related tokens also attracted significant activity despite SpaceX being a private company without a continuously available public-market reference price.

💰 Prices Mostly Followed Traditional Markets

🔄 DEXs Dominate Tokenized Stock Trading
🌐 Most activity occurred on decentralized exchanges, including PancakeSwap, Uniswap and other blockchain-native venues.
🏦 Centralized exchanges represented only a smaller portion of the tracked volume for several major tokenized assets.

🚀 Key Takeaway
💡 The Labor Day weekend demonstrated a major advantage of tokenized equities: stocks can continue trading even when traditional exchanges are closed.

ETH Brother Hao’s Operation Guide for September 9
 
Brother Hao interprets today’s ETH market! Ethereum overall maintains a sideways-to-upward, bullish-leaning trend. During the day, prices pushed up under resistance and then pulled back. Recently, bullish momentum has been strong: the 7-day gain exceeds 4.57%, and the monthly gain reaches as high as 31%. The medium-term uptrend structure remains very solid.
 
On the daily timeframe, all key moving averages are aligned in a bullish configuration. Price is firmly holding multiple EMA supports, and the critical Fibonacci support levels have not been broken either. The large-scale bullish trend has not been damaged at all. The only shortcoming is that multiple attempts to break through the 2500–2550 resistance band have failed. The MACD red histogram continues to shrink, indicating that short-term upward momentum has started to weaken.
 
On the four-hour chart, the market action fits a standard range-bound consolidation pattern. Short-term moving averages repeatedly intertwine, making the battle between bulls and bears tight and unresolved. Indicators alternate between bullish and bearish signals, with no clear one-direction signal. Downside support shows solid holding power; lows keep getting higher, and buying interest remains resilient.
 
Overall, ETH is in a period of bull accumulation and consolidation rather than a bearish pullback. Wait for a volume expansion to trigger an upside breakout. In the short term, 2463 is the pivot between bulls and bears: as long as support holds, there is room for a rebound. Brother Hao continues to look for longs today as well—build positions gradually on pullbacks in the 2485–2455 zone. The first short-term target is 2515. Abraxas Capital hedges $353M ETH short with $32M buy – Here’s why

Ethereum [$ETH] has stagnated, hovering between $2.4k and $2.5k. Moreover, with the prolonged sideways movement, $2.5k has turned out to be a stubborn resistance level.

At press time, Ethereum was trading around $2480, after slightly falling by 0.45% on the daily charts.

Abraxas Capital hedges $353M $ETH short
With $ETH trading in a narrow range, high net worth investors who expected a major slip are counting losses. In recent weeks, Abraxas Capital has been aggressively shorting the market.

Two weeks ago, AMBCrypto reported that Abraxas Capital had built $783 million worth of short positions on Hyperliquid and bought $173 million on the spot to hedge the risk. Since then, this position has reduced significantly. But still, liquidation risk for short positions remains extremely elevated.

In fact, $7.3 million worth of short positions were liquidated over the past 24 hours. Since Abraxas Capital understands the risk associated with such elevated leverage, it has turned to hedging on the spot.
According to Lookonchain, Abraxas Capital bought another 13,000 eth worth $32.39 million. The purchase aimed to hedge its 141,180 $ETH, worth $353.27 million, in short positions on Hyperliquid.

Abraxas Capital has been recently deploying this risk management, hoping one side could absorb risk from the other. Often, purchasing on the spot leaves Abraxas Capital safe, in case the price pumps and shorts are forced out of the market.

Can the spot buys boost eth price?
Although Ethereum has struggled to make an upside move, pressure remains minimal. This is evidenced by the fact that the Exchange Supply Ratio (ESR) has been on a decline over the past week.

In fact, at press time, ESR had dropped to late August levels, indicating that supply that surged in early September had been absorbed.
With the ESR dropping, it indicates more outflows compared to inflows, which have historically helped assets make gains on the charts.#Write2Earn #Ethereum $ETH

title: Bitcoin Dominance Is Falling — Altseason
subTitle:
Bitcoin has dominated the crypto market for much of 2026, but traders are now watching a potentially important shift: Bitcoin dominance is starting to lose ground.
The big question is simple:
Are we finally entering an altcoin season? 👀
📉 Why Bitcoin Dominance Matters
Bitcoin dominance measures Bitcoin’s share of the total cryptocurrency market capitalization.
When BTC dominance rises, capital is generally concentrated in Bitcoin.
When BTC dominance falls, it can indicate that traders are moving capital into Ethereum and other altcoins.
Current market data puts Bitcoin dominance around the high-50% range, while CoinMarketCap’s Altcoin Season Index uses a much stricter benchmark: at least 75% of the top 100 coins must outperform Bitcoin over 90 days to officially qualify as “Altcoin Season.”
So, falling dominance is interesting — but it does not automatically mean altseason has arrived.
🔥 What Could Trigger an Altcoin Rotation?
Several factors could strengthen the case for altcoins:
🔹 Bitcoin consolidating after its recent rally
🔹 Ethereum/BTC strength
🔹 Falling BTC dominance
🔹 Increasing trading volume across major altcoins
🔹 Improving liquidity and risk appetite
🔹 Positive regulatory developments
Bitcoin recently rallied strongly, reaching above $82,000 before pulling back toward the $78K–$80K region. That consolidation could potentially give traders more room to explore higher-risk assets.
⚠️ But There’s Still a Major Risk
Bitcoin dominance remains relatively high.
That means the market has not yet provided definitive confirmation of a broad altcoin season.
If Bitcoin suddenly drops sharply, altcoins could fall even harder.
Macro conditions are also critical. Markets are watching U.S. inflation data and the Federal Reserve’s upcoming policy decision, both of which could create significant volatility across crypto.
👀 What Traders Should Watch Next
The next few weeks could be important.
Watch these signals:
📊 BTC Dominance: Continued downside would strengthen the altseason argument.
₿ Bitcoin: A stable BTC price could encourage rotation into altcoins.
Ξ Ethereum: ETH/BTC strength would be an important confirmation signal.
💰 Market Volume: Rising altcoin volume would make the rotation more convincing.
🌎 Macro: Fed policy, inflation and liquidity remain major market catalysts.
🚀 Bottom Line
Bitcoin dominance falling is an interesting signal, but calling a full-blown altseason right now may be premature.
The real confirmation will come if Bitcoin stabilizes while Ethereum and major altcoins consistently outperform BTC.
If that happens, the crypto market could enter a much broader rotation.
Is altseason finally coming — or is this just another temporary BTC dominance pullback? 👇
#Bitcoin #BTC #Ethereum✅  #ETH #Altcoins

title: 💥 太惨烈！过去24小时全网爆仓2.26亿美元，7.6万人血本无归！
subTitle:
过去24小时里加密货币市场相对过去的一段时间来说并不太平，柿场波动加剧，超7.6w名投资者仓位被动调整
据第三方数据平台统计，截至今日早间，过去24小时内全球加密货币市场因剧烈震荡，导致约7.6w个交易账户出现仓位被动平仓，累计涉及资金约2.26亿美金。其中，多头方向仓位约1.16亿美金，空头方向约1.1亿美金，哆箜双方均受到较大冲击。剧业内人士分析，此次波动主要受地缘政治、宏观政策预期及技术层面安全事件三重因素叠加影响。

以下是各主要品种资金变动情况
 ETH：哆投方向仓位变动约2,238万美元，箜投方向更是达到约2,423万美元。
BTC：相比ETH更是有过之而无不及，哆投方向仓位变动约3,869万美元，箜投方向约3,033万美元。单笔最大变动涉及金额达到约296万美金。

行情波动的三大背景因素
① 地缘冲突推升能源价格：近期中东局势紧张，布伦特原油价格逼近每桶100美金，市场对通胀回升的担忧增强，风险资产整体承压。
② 美联储政策预期变化：最新就业数据好于预期，市场对9月加息的概率预期升至约58%，明晚即将公布的CPI数据成为短期关键观察节点，资金观望情绪浓厚。
③ 技术平台安全事件：Blockstream旗下Liquid Network因软件漏洞被利用，约4,000枚LBTC（价值约3.2亿美金）被异常提取。目前已有3,400枚被返还，剩余约598枚仍在处理中，该事件对市场情绪产生一定扰动。

短期市场情绪指标
BTC价格目前在7.9w附近震荡，技术指标MACD显示短期动能偏弱，恐慌与贪婪指数从74回落至66，市场处于方向选择前的观望阶段。明晚美国CPI数据公布后，市场波动可能进一步加大，投资者需密切关注。

title: 📈 Trailing Up en Spot Grid: Cómo acompañar la tendencia sin romper tu Rango
subTitle:
Uno de los principales desafíos al operar un bot de Spot Grid ocurre cuando el precio de un activo rompe con fuerza el límite superior del rango trazado. Tradicionalmente, cuando esto sucede, el bot vende la totalidad de las criptomonedas compradas y se detiene en USDT, quedando fuera de la continuación del movimiento alcista.

La función Trailing Up resuelve esta limitación desplazando automáticamente todo el rango hacia arriba a medida que el mercado hace nuevos máximos.

1. ¿Cómo funciona la mecánica del Trailing Up?

En lugar de mantener una grilla estática e inamovible, la función Trailing Up ajusta los límites en tiempo real:

Desplazamiento Dinámico: Cuando el precio supera el límite superior previamente establecido, el bot mueve proporcionalmente tanto el límite superior como el inferior hacia arriba.

Mantenimiento de la Grilla: Conserva la misma cantidad de grillas y la separación porcentual entre órdenes, permitiendo que el bot continúe comprando y vendiendo de forma ininterrumpida durante una tendencia alcista sostenida en $BTC, $ETH o$BNB.

2. Beneficios clave frente a la Grilla Estática

Maximización de ganancias en tendencia: Evita vender todo tu inventario en las primeras etapas de una ruptura alcista importante.

Automatización del ajuste: Elimina la necesidad de cerrar el bot manualmente para volver a crear uno nuevo con un rango más alto.

三周期现在是"日线压回MA7上方、4h动量重新翻红、1h中性偏强"的修复局，跟昨晚"4h二次翻空"正好对调。1h收2500.79，踩在MA7(2500.66)/MA25(2491.19)/MA50(2488.54)/MA99(2488.90)全部上方，短均线重新多头排列；RSI 54.86中性偏强，MACD柱子+0.15（dif 3.74压dea 3.59）刚翻红——小时级动能由弱转稳。4h是今晚真转折：收2500.97，重新站回MA7(2494.39)/MA25(2488.90)/MA50(2466.85)/MA99(2467.80)整堆均线，架子收回来了；RSI 54.43中性，MACD柱子+0.56（dif 6.68压dea 6.12）翻红——这是从昨晚-3.35绿柱之后，4h第二次动能转正，昨晚那波回吐被吃掉。1d收2500.79，稳站MA7(2489.60)/MA25(2385.50)/MA50(2138.52)/MA99(1936.00)全上方，中期多头没坏；但RSI 49.54中性，MACD柱子-15.21（dif 102.95压dea 118.16）还是绿的——从2566下来的日线冷却已连五根为负，只是比昨晚-15.66收窄，警报没解除。

今晚读成"2430-2440平台二度守住后的反抽修复，4h动量重新翻红"，跟昨晚"二次翻空"正好反过来。2500踩回整堆短均线、4h MACD翻红、量能放大，短线这个修复是实的。但我不在2500上方追：日线MACD还绿着、2566铁顶 + 2536/2522两道反压在头顶，而且价涨OI降、ETH/BTC负，这口反弹底气不算足。有仓的止损挂2440.22（今日低）下方，破了认短弱先撤——尤其global 70.87%的拥挤净多，2430一旦失守这批杠杆多就是清算引线。没仓别在2500追，等两个信号：要么放量站回2522不回头、4h MACD柱子继续放大认短多延续，要么回踩2488-2491均线叠区不破企稳再轻仓接。中线大结构（日MA全多头、MA50 2138远在脚下）没坏，但2566双顶 + 日线MACD连续绿柱，决定了这里先当反弹做、别当反转梭；仓位控小，等日线柱子翻红、2566被有效突破，那才是趋势再起的确认。

🔴 BTC kehilangan $77K–78K

【Bitmine’s shopping spree—I’ve been watching it for a week, and there’s one thing I have to say】

To be honest, lately I’ve been watching ETH, but I wasn’t mainly looking at the chart. I was watching Bitmine.

In just over a week, these folks swept up nearly 28,000 ETH, completing 97% of the target for accumulating 5% of the total Ethereum supply. After Tom Lee’s team finished buying, they still had the execution power to keep adding. Tom DeMark even came out and said, “The uptrend will be back in motion soon.”

In the past, I might have just treated it like a large holder building a position. But this time I thought about it for several more days.

Ask yourself: can this actually be carried out, and does the business logic hold water?

Bitmine’s strategy, at its core, is to treat Ethereum like corporate treasury bonds and hoard it. Their current logic is: ETH has staking yields and ecosystem value support; compared with Bitcoin it’s more volatile, but also has more upside. Institutions lock up huge amounts in a treasury-like form, which objectively reduces circulating supply.

Can this really run? There are two key points:

First, when will regulation become clear. The treasury structure still has gray areas under traditional financial compliance frameworks. The stances of the U.S. SEC and Hong Kong’s SFC will directly affect how quickly new funds can come in.

Second, can Ethereum’s ecosystem continue to “bleed and grow.” Can staking rewards remain sustainable? Can Layer 2 keep bringing real transaction volume? Will the developer ecosystem keep expanding? These are the underlying drivers. The quantum-resistance deadline in 2029 isn’t the most urgent thing right now, but it is indeed a risk anchor.

Right now, ETH is stuck in the range of 2423 to 2571. Trading volume isn’t bad, but it isn’t strong either. Bitmine’s continued buying gives the market an expectation of support at the bottom, but market sentiment (FNG 66) hasn’t reached the euphoric stage.

My judgment remains the same: in the long run, Ethereum’s logic hasn’t broken—institutions are making their stance with real money. In the short run, it’s just consolidation while we wait for a catalyst.

What have you been watching lately? Institutional moves, or ecosystem data? #ETH #加密分析 #LAPTOP #Market Insights

【Bitmine扫货这件事，我盯了一周，有句话必须说】

老实讲，最近我盯ETH，主要盯的不是盘面，是Bitmine。

这帮人一周多时间扫了快2.8万个ETH，完成了5%以太坊总供应积累目标的97%。Tom Lee的团队买完还有执行力继续加码，Tom DeMark还出来说“上行趋势马上恢复”。

换成以前，我可能就当大户建仓看了。但这次我多想了几天。

你看这事能不能落地、商业逻辑通不通？

Bitmine的打法本质上是把以太坊当企业国债来囤。它现在的逻辑是：ETH有staking收益、有生态价值支撑、相对比特币波动更大但潜力也更大。机构用 treasury 的形式大量锁仓，客观上造成流通筹码减少。

这事能不能真跑起来，有两个关键点：

一是监管什么时候明确。 treasury 结构在传统金融合规框架下还有模糊地带，美国SEC、香港SFC的态度会直接影响后续资金进来的速度。

二是ETH本身的生态能不能继续造血。质押收益能不能维持、Layer2能不能持续带来真实交易量、开发者生态会不会继续增长——这些才是底层逻辑。量子抵抗2029年的deadline倒不是眼下最紧迫的，但确实是个风险锚点。

现在ETH卡在2423到2571这个区间，成交量不算差但也不算强。Bitmine的持续买入给了一个底部支撑预期，但市场情绪（FNG 66）还没到亢奋阶段。

我还是那个判断：长期看，以太坊的逻辑没坏，机构在用真金白银表态。短期就是震荡，等一个催化剂。

【Week up 4.7%, what is ETH waiting for】

A week ago it was still hovering below 2,400; today it’s $ 2496—up by roughly five percentage points. How about a month ago? That was around $ 2350. In comparison, ETH is actually quietly climbing upward, it’s just not climbing fast enough to give people that kind of “wow” excitement.

But what’s truly interesting isn’t the price—it’s two things happening at the same time.

First: Bitmine, the company, has swept nearly 28,000 ETH over the past period, completing its 5% target for the Ethereum supply. When I saw this number for the first time, I was stunned—not because of the amount, but because of their logic. Institutional-grade capital is building its position according to plan, and at the current pace, they can finish the target in about seven weeks.

Second: the Ethereum Foundation has listed quantum resistance as a priority through before 2029. In plain terms, the encryption algorithms used in crypto today could be broken by quantum computers at some point in the future. Their estimated window is around before 2030. That means the upcoming upgrades all need to be geared toward that deadline.

Put these two together—what can you see?

Institutions are steadily absorbing at lower levels, while the project team is preemptively defusing risks. What does this combination imply? Smart money is betting that ETH’s fundamentals will keep getting stronger—not betting that it will jump tomorrow, but betting that it will still be alive three to five years from now, and even better off.

As for whether it can actually play out—does the business logic hold?

Let me tell you: when truly big capital enters, they never look only at short-term candlestick charts. They look at how much real business the chain can support in the future—how much will run on it. Right now, Ethereum’s TVL, gas consumption, and number of ecosystem applications are all there. The ecosystem hasn’t died; it’s still growing. With quantum security being addressed, technical risk gets pushed further out, and institutional confidence gets an extra layer.

ETH is currently hovering around 2,900, about half down from its all-time high. At this level, long-term money thinks it’s worth it, while short-term money thinks it’s not exciting enough. Totally normal—this happens every time.

What do you think about this move? With institutions sweeping according to plan and the project team preemptively clearing risks, do you think this combination is enough to support a long-term thesis?

第一件，Bitmine这家公司，过去一段时间扫了将近2.8万个ETH，完成了5%以太坊供应量目标。这个数字我第一次看到的时候愣了一下——不是金额大，是他们的逻辑。机构级别的资金在按计划建仓，而且按现在的速度，七周左右就能把目标跑完。

第二件，以太坊基金会把量子抗性列为了2029年前的优先事项。说白了，今天的加密算法在未来某一天可能被量子计算机攻破，这个时间窗口他们预估在2030年前后。所以接下来的升级都要对着这个deadline来。

机构在低位持续吸货，同时项目方在提前排雷风险。这种组合意味着什么？聪明钱在赌ETH的基本面会越来越扎实——不是赌它明天涨，而是赌它三五年后还活着，而且活得更好。

我跟你说，真正的大资金入场，从来不是看短期K线。他们看的是这个链未来能承载多少真实业务，能有多少东西在上面跑。现在以太坊的TVL、Gas消耗、生态应用数量摆在那，生态没死，还在长。量子安全这一块补上了，技术风险往后推，机构持有的信心就多一层。

你们怎么看这波？机构按计划扫货，项目方提前排雷，这种组合你觉得够不够支撑一个长线逻辑？

37 European banks have moved euro stablecoins onto Ethereum, and the real game is just beginning with a staggering $300 billion

Today, the most worth thinking about isn’t the market—it's a piece of news: 37 European banks have jointly moved euro stablecoins onto Ethereum. According to media estimates, this is behind a $300 billion market. Compared with today’s broader market, ETH is only up a modest 1.36%, trading at a little over $2,500—but the weight of this news is probably far greater than a single candlestick. #ETH  

Stablecoins have always been the shortest bridge between the crypto world and traditional finance. With the US dollar stablecoin market getting crowded and turning into a red ocean, this move by European banks is essentially building “a euro version” of payment infrastructure directly on Ethereum. Why Ethereum instead of building their own chain? The logic is simple: they want existing liquidity and a settlement network—not to set up a whole new table from scratch. The narrative of big institutions coming in as customers is more compelling than just pushing the price up. 

Let’s compare with today’s leaders: Bitcoin is hovering around $79,000, up about 1% over the past 24 hours. XRP, on the other hand, is performing better—up nearly 4%. They don’t have any negative catalysts, but they also aren’t exactly delivering explosive news. Instead, this euro stablecoin story opens another door for the entire industry. #BTC  

In the end, prices go up and down, but what truly lasts is whoever is willing to build infrastructure solidly. When stablecoins move on-chain, what’s being transferred is trust; when a group of people come together to keep working on something long-term, what they’re really gathering is momentum. This kind of big-picture thinking reminds me of the little dog from Silicon Valley’s Iron Man—not relying on short-term volatility to grab attention, but slowly growing something into its own.
